cases.sentence: бейся с теми, кто бьется со ___.
cases.explain: The preposition со (with) in this context governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: сражайся с теми, кто сражается со ___.
cases.explain: The preposition со (with) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Возьми щиты ___ и приди мне на помощь.
cases.explain: The noun латы (armor/buckler) is the direct object in the imperative construction, taking the accusative case which equals the nominative for this plural noun.

cases.sentence: поднови ___ на тех, кто меня преследует.
cases.explain: The verb поднови (brandish) takes the accusative case for its direct object. Копье is inanimate, so nominative and accusative are identical.
The verb раскинули (spread) takes the accusative case for its direct object.
The verb вырыли (dug) takes the accusative case for its direct object яму.
The preposition против (against) governs the genitive case.
The preposition при (in front of/at) with the meaning of location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Господи, бейся с теми, кто бьется со мной, сражайся с теми, кто сражается со мной.
reading.question: What does the psalmist ask the Lord to do?
options: Fight those who fight against him
reading.correct: Fight those who fight against him
reading.explain: The text explicitly asks the Lord to бейся с теми, кто бьется со мной (fight those who fight against me).

reading.ru: Возьми щиты латы и приди мне на помощь, подними копье и секиру на тех, кто меня преследует.
reading.question: What weapons does the psalmist ask God to take up?
reading.explain: The text lists щиты, латы, копье, and секиру (shield, buckler, spear, and axe) as the weapons to take up.

reading.ru: За то, что они мне раскинули сеть без причины и без повода вырыли яму, пусть нежданно придет к ним гибель.
reading.question: According to the psalmist, why should destruction come upon his enemies?
options: Because they laid traps for him without cause
Because they stole from the poor
reading.correct: Because they laid traps for him without cause
reading.explain: The text states они мне раскинули сеть без причины и без повода вырыли яму (they set traps for me without reason and dug a pit without cause).

reading.ru: Но когда они болели, я одевался в рубище и постом себя изнурял.
reading.question: How did the psalmist respond when his enemies were sick?
reading.explain: The text says я одевался в рубище и постом себя изнурял (I put on sackcloth and afflicted myself with fasting) showing his compassion.

reading.ru: И когда молитва моя возвращалась ко мне без ответа, я ходил, сокрушаясь, как по другу или по брату.
reading.question: What did the psalmist do when his prayers went unanswered?
options: He grieved as he would for a friend or brother
reading.correct: He grieved as he would for a friend or brother
reading.explain: The text describes the psalmist's response: я ходил, сокрушаясь, как по другу или по брату (I walked about mourning as one would for a friend or brother).

reading.ru: Я восславлю тебя при большом собрании, среди бесчисленного народа восхвалю тебя.
reading.question: Where does the psalmist promise to praise God?
options: In a great assembly and among countless people
reading.correct: In a great assembly and among countless people
reading.explain: The text says при большом собрании, среди бесчисленного народа (in the great assembly, among the countless people).
